strAuthor: phobosgekko; guidance adapted from Gravy/mrkmg's Auto Navigate
strNotes: Includes the Phobos Polaris Auto Nav Module for Polaris navigation stations. Translation catalogs with English fallback; language selection through Phobos Framework. Torch-preferred approach with native no-wake protection and RCS fallback; short-range approach below 5,000 km; 1 km default stopping distance, adjustable to 100 m subject to hull clearance. Ordinary saves supported. Saved flights resume after validation; blocked flights remain suspended for explicit Resume. Requires BepInEx 5, the accompanying PhobosAutoNav plugin and Phobos Framework 0.11.0+. Available from traders or table assembly, with repair, Restore and mass-balanced dismantling. No Auto Navigate dependency. Does not dock or avoid obstacles. Original Phobos artwork; adaptation provenance in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Economy integration awaits in-game testing.
